description: This file defines the Ec2ParamBuilder class, responsible for serializing EC2 parameters within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends QueryParamBuilder and provides methods for generating query parameter names and serializing list parameters for EC2 API requests.

classes.name: Ec2ParamBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds query parameters specifically for EC2 API requests, including formatting list parameters and determining parameter naming conventions.

methods.name: queryName
methods.description: Returns the query parameter name for a given shape, defaulting to the shape's 'queryName' or 'locationName', or a default string.

methods.name: isFlat
methods.description: Indicates whether the shape is a flat structure; always returns false for this builder.

methods.name: format_list
methods.description: Serializes a list shape into query parameters, handling empty lists and formatting each list item with incremental indices.
